headlines.title: Google and Meta face massive fines for addictive features
headlines.summary: Tech giants face billions in fines under Australia’s internet safety bill

headlines.title: Cloud AI Update - Audi Integrates Cutting-Edge AI for In-Car Microsoft Access
headlines.summary: Recent developments in Cloud AI have seen a significant advancement with the introduction of the Mobile Work Agent, co-developed by Audi, Cerence AI, and Microsoft, now being integrated into select Audi vehicles. This new functionality leverages large language model technology to provide secure, voice-first access to Microsoft 365 apps like Teams and Outlook directly from the car, marking a solution to previous challenges around enterprise security for vehicle-based work tools.

headlines.title: Elon Musk Reportedly Told Staff SpaceX Is Falling Behind in AI
headlines.summary: Musk's own yardstick for AI success is revenue per GPU, and by that measure SpaceX's smartest move may be helping its rivals win. The catch is a short exit clause that could unravel the whole bet.

headlines.title: OpenAI’s Greg Brockman: “The World Is Not Building Enough Compute.” Wall Street Just Stopped Raising Capex Forecasts
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysOpenAI President Greg Brockman says the world is short on compute, but analysts didn’t raise their capex forecasts for Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft or Meta during third-quarter earnings season. Analysts expect Nvidia’s revenue to grow 71% in the fiscal year ending January 2028, faster than its biggest customers’ capex.

headlines.title: Not Apple. Not Microsoft. This Is the "Magnificent Seven" Stock I’d Buy for a 10-Year Hold.
headlines.summary: Alphabet’s search business is thriving, its cloud arm is surging, and now it owns a hefty piece of a $1.2 trillion AI company.

description: Alphabet Inc. offers various products and platforms in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, Canada, and Latin America. It operates through Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets segments. The Google Services segment provides products and services, including ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. It is also involved in the sale of apps and in-app purchases and digital content in Google Play and YouTube; and devices, as well as the provision of YouTube consumer subscription services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, NFL Sunday Ticket, and Google One. The Google Cloud segment offers consumption-based fees and subscriptions for AI solutions, including AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini enterprise. It also provides cybersecurity, and data and analytics services; Google Workspace that include cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Calendar, Gmail, Docs, Drive, and Meet; and other enterprise services. The Other Bets segment sells transportation and internet services. Alphabet Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
